messages:
Sasha: Quick question — for the canary rollout of the new embed-splitter, what should the console surface as the authoritative signal: 'shape propagated' (client-provided) vs 'runtime-decided'?
Mike: I was assuming preflight/console should prefer client hints when present. clients can send X-Embed-Shape header.
Deepa: Agree but we should show both. Console: 'shape hint rate' + 'runtime overrides %' so SRE/product can see divergence.
Tom: Telemetry cardinality worries me if we start surfacing every distinct dim combo. can we bucket?
Sasha: Example of an ingress line for visibility: `INFO [ingress] tenant=acme route=embeds v=1 hint=dim:1536 split=async reason=oversize bytes=1.2MB`
Mike: For header format we suggested earlier: ```X-Embed-Shape: dims=1536,count=3``` simple and low-cardinality.
Deepa: UX proposal: in route details show a small histogram: hinted shapes (top 5) + % that routed to preflight split vs runtime split. Also an estimate column: "estimated units saved" if preflight had been respected.
Tom: Also flag mixed-dim payloads (e.g., 512+1536) as a separate class. Those cause the splitter to fragment into many small jobs — huge perf regressions. alert on >0.5% of requests.
Sasha: Good point. We should add an alert rule (console) when fragmentation rate spikes.
Mike: Implementation note: runtime should emit `router.decision={hinted,preflight,override}` as a tag so console can aggregate. keep tag values small.
Deepa: We'll need a backfill script to compute baseline preflight vs runtime split rates for the canary window. I can write a k8s job.
Sasha: Action items: Deepa -> mockup console widgets (histogram + savings estimate). Mike -> add router.decision tag + instrument header parsing. Tom -> define fragmentation alert threshold. I will coordinate with SRE.
ingress-bot: deploy: canary rollout eng-platform/embed-splitter v2 -> success :white_check_mark: (2024-04-11T15:42:01Z)
Tom: tiny nit — make sure we don't expose tenant ids in the public console dashboard, only aggregated metrics.
Sasha: agreed. we'll surface example tenant *counts* and anonymized sample ids.
Mike: :thumbsup:
Deepa: I'll drop a short PR with the console screenshots by EOD.
Sasha: thanks all — will circle back after the first canary hour and check the 'runtime override' rate.
